The main task of this quarter is to make the solid oxide fuel cell test station in ORNL working and finish all the necessary calibration with a commercial button cell. The button cell was purchased from Fuel Cell Store, which is an electrolyte supported button cell with an effective anode/cathode diameter of 1.25 cm on an electrolyte support of 2.5 cm diameter. The anode and cathode are ~50 μm thick, while the electrolyte is ~ 130 to 170 µm thick. The anode is NiO- GDC/NiO-YSZ, while the cathode is LSM/LSM-GDC, with the electrolyte is scandia-stabilized zirconia (ScSZ) substrate (Hionic). Figure 24 shows the in-house test station and the assembled button cell fixture, which allows control of temperature, gas composition, and flow rate.
